instruction: Please add both workspace1.code-workspace and workspace2.code-workspace to the current workspace using the 'Add Workspace to Workspace' command.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have an 'Add Workspace to Workspace' command. While VS Code has 'Add Folder to Workspace' to add individual folders, there is no command to add entire workspace files to another workspace. Workspaces can only contain folder references, not other workspace files.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: No 'Add Workspace to Workspace' command exists in VS Code
